game.title: Path of Exile
game.blurb: Online action RPG of loot, skill gems and a huge passive tree, set in Wraeclast, from Grinding Gear Games, released 2013-10-23. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, RPG, Massively Multiplayer, Indie. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign, Part 1
chapters.summary: From the Twilight Strand to Dominus, the Scion, Malachai and the end of Part 1.

chapters.title: The Campaign, Part 2 and Completion
chapters.summary: The Part 2 gods and the Depraved Trinity, plus every waypoint, side quest, dialogue and lore find.

chapters.title: The Labyrinth and Ascendancy
chapters.summary: The Labyrinth on every difficulty, Izaro and choosing an Ascendancy class.

chapters.title: Maps and the Atlas
chapters.summary: Opening and corrupting maps, Voidstones, Scarabs and completing the Atlas.

chapters.title: End-game Bosses
chapters.summary: Atziri, the Elder, the Shaper, Sirus, the Maven, the Breachlords and the four last bosses.

chapters.title: Masters, Leagues, Races and PvP
chapters.summary: Master missions, Essences, Warbands, Strongboxes, special areas, races, parties and PvP.

chapters.title: Hardcore Leagues
chapters.summary: Levelling and the Labyrinth on a Hardcore character.

chapters.title: Character, Gems and Items
chapters.summary: Levels, skill gems, sockets, uniques, crafting, corruption, the passive tree and the Pantheon.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). RAWG's first result, "path-of-exile" (id 10533), is the first game; "Path of Exile 2" is a separate entry and Steam app (2694490), so app 238960 was used. No StrategyWiki page under "Path of Exile". pathofexile.fandom.com answers the API, but the game page is marked as a stub and links to only 13 articles, mostly expansion names such as "The Fall of Oriath", "Atlas of Worlds (expansion)", "Betrayal" and "Forsaken Masters"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 127 Steam achievements is hidden. The game is online and keeps adding content, so the later achievements (Sirus, the Maven and the four "Defeat The ..." bosses at the end of the list) reflect later updates; chapters are grouped by theme, not by update. "Part 1" and "Part 2" come from the achievements "Complete Part 1" and "Complete Part 2"; bosses were placed in a part by their Steam order and unlock rate, which is a judgement call. "Loyal to the End" (Kill Argus, 9%) does not say where Argus is, so it sits with side content as a placeholder; "Deicide" and the two Pantheon goals sit with Character, Gems and Items. RAWG lists a playtime of only 6 hours, which looks very low for this game.
